name: Expert-pool region-level Oracle / contribution audit (doc 21 Phase 1, R0 info-value gate)
question: Before building any router, does a region-level oracle over the frozen expert pool {E0 A1, E1 text-evidence, E2 LLSE, E3 CSS} have enough, spread, and leave-one-out-stable headroom over A1 on MPDD seed0/k1? If the gates below fail, doc 21 says stop the router and branch (BC-MCR / archive).

experts.E0_A1: frozen A1 map: fused concat (dino vitb14 + clip w=0.5, per-patch L2) 1-NN distance/2 -> dists2map(448) -> stride-8 (56x56); identity must reproduce frozen mean Pixel-AP ~0.3092 (s0 k1)
experts.E1_TEXT: TCRR raw text evidence = AnomalyCLIP text-conditioned anomaly_maps (448) from outputs/dynamic_fusion/innovation_v8_tcrr_probe/text_maps, robust01(m[::8,::8]) as in v8; RAW evidence, NOT the v8 final multiplier output (doc 21 4.2)
experts.E2_LLSE: top-8 local-linear-manifold reconstruction residual map (k=8, reg=1e-3) -> dists2map(448) -> stride-8
experts.E3_CSS: intra-image context self-similarity (24 neighbours, Chebyshev r=2) -> dists2map(448) -> stride-8

method.grid: all experts unified on the SAME 56x56 stride-8 grid of the same sample ids (alignment by sample_id order permutation)
method.regions: evaluator-side offline partition per image (GT masks used ONLY for the audit partition, never for inference/training): defect regions = 8-connected components of gt masks56; background = complement
method.oracle_choice: per-region pick expert e* maximizing mean robust01-normalized score inside a DEFECT region (best-hit); the single BACKGROUND region is always the DEFAULT/fallback expert E0_A1 (doc 21 selective-fallback semantics) - avoids cross-expert raw-scale FP contamination on normal pixels. Final oracle pixel map = E0_A1 raw map everywhere, with each defect region overwritten by its chosen expert's RAW map. Leave-one-out for E0 replaces background by the least-background-active remaining expert.
method.amendment_20260903b: initial spec picked a background expert by argmin background activation; a dry run on bracket_white collapsed (oracle AP 0.0012 << A1) from raw-scale contamination of the chosen background expert across normal pixels. Background now fixed to A1 default (fallback semantics). No results reported from the discarded run.
method.audit_metrics: Pixel-AP / AUROC computed exactly as the frozen protocol (stride-8 pooled per category) on raw maps

gates.g0_identity: recomputed E0 mean Pixel-AP within 1e-4 of frozen 0.3092
gates.g1_headroom: region-oracle vs A1 mean delta Pixel-AP >= +0.020
gates.g3_contrib: >= 2 non-A1 experts each >= 10% of oracle-selected defect pixels (defect pixels in components whose chosen expert is non-A1)
gates.g4_loo: removing ANY core expert drops oracle headroom by >= 0.003
gates.g5_dominance: headroom NOT > 50% from a single category
gates.stop_rule: doc 21 Phase 1: if gates fail -> stop RSR; branch to BC-MCR or archive. No per-category tuning; if seed0/k1 passes -> extend to seed0 x k{2,4} before any router work.

leakage.oracle: GT used only offline in the evaluator to construct the audit partition (auxiliary oracle audit); no trained module reads GT; route features (if any later) exclude category identity and test aggregates
leakage.note: doc 21 s9.4 permits evaluator-side offline GT for oracle/regret audits
